frozenBefore: any capture, any measurement and any engine change; the rules hash is recorded in the replay-set manifest

comparison.unit: the same pick moment (replay of a frozen moment through the real routes, no bot in the loop)
comparison.primarySurface: Team Coach Board, column of the recommended position, top 3
comparison.fullOutputFingerprint: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the whole MomentOutput (board columns with reasons, V4 cards with rationale and risks, V3 list, counterTop3)

definitions.closingWindow: own picks remaining in {1, 2}, where remaining = 5 - number of visible own picks (engine function ownPicksRemainingFor)
definitions.eligible: closingWindow AND every visible own pick has curated capabilities (the engine only declares critical gaps in that case)
definitions.structuralGapOpen: eligible AND assessCompositionNeedsOf(...).open contains structural_damage (computed on F1 code, before any change)
definitions.A2: subset of A that already had at least one critical gap under F1 (initiation, catch or damage_mix): criticalPressure can change for them; reported separately
definitions.fills: filledGaps(candidate capabilities, [gap], ownDamageTypes) contains the gap; a hero without curated capabilities fills nothing and is never counted as lacking
definitions.GapFill@3: share of applicable moments where at least one of the primary-surface top-3 heroes fills the gap
definitions.ExposureTop3: sum over the primary-surface top-3 of curated HARD counters still available (checks.ts availableHardCounters, unchanged)
definitions.AdverseCounterTop3: number of primary-surface top-3 heroes whose statistical counter evidence is adverse under checks.ts isAdverse with M1_THRESHOLDS, unchanged; reported, never a verdict input

P0.statement: prevalence of structuralGapOpen among eligible moments >= 5%

P1.statement: GapFill@3 on A (same moments) improves by >= 20 percentage points over F1
P1.inconclusiveIf: |A| < 30 OR F1 GapFill@3 on A > 80% (the +20 points are not reachable)

P2.pass: number of B moments whose full-output fingerprint differs from F1 == 0

P4.statement: no invariant violation and no undue promotion of uncurated heroes
P4.pass: illegal hero in any shown list == 0 AND CRITICAL_GAP shown without proof == 0 AND CRITICAL_GAP missing == 0 AND uncurated hero entering a top-3 that was not in F1's == 0, over all moments

P5_otherGaps.statement: the change does not hurt other critical gaps
P5_otherGaps.pass: for each of initiation, catch, damage_mix: GapFill@3(E1) >= GapFill@3(F1) - 5 points on the moments where that gap is critical
P5_otherGaps.inconclusiveIf: fewer than 10 moments for that gap (reported per gap)

verdict.FAIL: any of P0..P5 conclusively not met
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: none failed and at least one is inconclusive
verdict.PASS: all of P0..P5 met with their denominators
verdict.note: A numeric PASS is not a strategic improvement. The blind evaluation of the modified decisions is required before E1 is kept; its result is reported separately and never retunes a threshold.

report: every denominator is printed next to its ratio; thresholds are not changed after results are known
